summary: Independent E2E pass for R00-R17 + F01-F09 against the ISOLATED store-review scope on the live preview (https://app-first-signin.preview.emergentagent.com). Ran 21 focused API checks over the six synthetic reviewer accounts (customer / admin / two telecallers / billing / upload). 19 PASS, 1 SKIP (audience preview endpoint not exposed under a GET-alias variant), 1 FAIL - the R13-B daily 03:00 IST release fixture 'review-request-stale-0001' is STILL owned by review-telecaller-0001 (age 27 h) even though queue_release.current_cycle.status=='completed' and 54 rows were released today (worker OK). Browser evidence captured for the Login -> Help -> App review access -> Open reviewer sign-in flow (login-help-link, help-review-access-link, reviewer-id-input, reviewer-key-input, review-login-btn all present; legacy review-access-link on /login removed). Native-only behaviours (Android/iOS keyboard, OTP autofill, pinch gestures, hardware Back, rich image push delivery) explicitly not verified in this Chromium/Playwright runtime and are marked as such. Reviewer access keys were read from /tmp/yash-private/e2e-review-keys.json in code only and never printed, logged or screenshotted.

critical.issue: R13-B/F04 REGRESSION - The seeded stale fixture is still assigned to review-telecaller-0001 (assignee_id/assigned_to both set, age_seconds ~97 500). /api/requests/queue/status shows the 03:00 IST release worker is running (worker_running=true), current_cycle.id=2026-09-20, released=54, completed_at=2026-09-20T10:44:33Z, so the boundary DID cross, but this specific fixture was NOT reset (no 'Released at 03:00 x1' chip, reset_count not incremented in the response). Suggests the review-scope release query does not select this document (possible id-filter/scope-prefix mismatch, or the fixture is re-seeded on every startup AFTER the release cycle). Blocks the F04 acceptance criterion.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 503 (status=not_ready) because flows.staff.ready=false / STAFF_SERVICE_KEY still a placeholder in preview .env. Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md this is DELIBERATE for preview, but external monitors will trip on the 503 - document the expected 503 state or expose a separate /api/health/preview readiness so store-review readiness (flows.review.ready=true, accounts_enabled=6) is not masked.

HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed. If the composer preview lives on POST /api/admin/notifications/audience/preview it should also accept a GET or the composer's exact path/method should be documented in /api/requests/catalog-style metadata; today reviewers cannot discover it from the OpenAPI surface easily.

rca_of_issue: R13-B failure RCA: /api/requests/queue/status confirms the 03:00 IST worker executed today (current_cycle.status='completed', released=54 at 2026-09-20T10:44:33Z). But GET /api/requests/review-request-stale-0001 still returns assignee_id='review-telecaller-0001', assigned_to='review-telecaller-0001', age_seconds ~97 500. Two most likely causes: (a) shared/review_seed.py re-seeds the fixture on every backend startup with a fresh claim so it looks 'younger than today's boundary' to the release worker; (b) the release worker's scope-aware query in shared/queue_reset.py does not include the review__requests collection or filters out documents with synthetic assignees. Reproduction: (1) restart backend, (2) GET /api/requests/queue/status -> current_cycle completed, (3) GET /api/requests/review-request-stale-0001 -> still assigned. Mitigation: seed the fixture with claimed_at older than the last-completed boundary AND ensure shared/queue_reset.py iterates review__requests for review scope; add a pytest that stubs `now()` past the next 03:00 IST boundary and asserts reset_count grew by 1.
